title: The Digital Judiciary — reference implementation, simulation corpora and benchmark
description: Reference implementation of the Digital Judiciary architecture for governed precedent in software-change adjudication; five executed 6,000-case simulation corpora (simulation pack 2.4.0, corpus data 2.1.0) with constitutions, reference adjudicator, conformance suites and mutation matrices; the benchmark harness comparing governed precedent against monolithic per-case reasoning and a priced human review desk; and, since 5.16.0, the Enterprise Conscience fast track (tiered canon, dispensation-token registry, conscience gate, examen log) coupled to the judiciary through a bench, with its 365-day five-company driver, conformance suite, mutation matrix and preregistration. Code Apache-2.0; corpora, constitutions, canons and documents CC BY 4.0.
